description:
Summarize a whole time series into one activity image.

    Pass the STAC URLs of a site's passes; the timescan encodes per-pixel
    temporal statistics so bright/colored areas are *where activity happened*
    over the series. Returns the image block plus attribution.

db.description: Decibel stretch instead of a linear percentile stretch. Default false.
db.title: Db

max_size.description: Overview size cap in pixels for each pass. Default 1024.
max_size.title: Max Size

urls.description: STAC JSON URLs or item ids of at least two passes of one site.
urls.title: Urls

name: timescan
